u1-l1#ahoj.picture: On a sunny university courtyard, Emma meets Lucia and Tomáš, who are walking up together. All three greet each other casually, hands raised.

u1-l1#dobry-den.picture: Emma walks into a small bakery. The baker, crouching to stock a low shelf of loaves, looks up and greets her.

u1-l1#dobre-rano.picture: Early morning on a Bratislava street, low sun. Emma, holding a takeaway coffee, meets pani Horváthová walking to the university with a briefcase. They greet each other.

u1-l1#dobry-vecer.picture: Evening on the street outside the dormitory, streetlamps lit. Emma, coming home, greets an older neighbour and her small grandson walking past.

u1-l1#dovidenia.picture: Emma leaves the bakery with a paper bag of rolls, turning in the doorway to say goodbye to the baker.

u1-l1#dobru-noc.picture: Late at night outside a cinema, under a streetlamp, Emma and Lucia part ways, waving good night to each other.

u1-l1#dobru-chut.picture: In the university canteen, Emma, carrying her lunch tray, passes pani Horváthová eating at a table and wishes her a good meal.

u1-l1#choice-dobru-noc.picture: Late at night in Emma and Lucia's dorm room, moon in the window. Lucia, in pyjamas and yawning, is getting into bed.

u1-l2#dakujem.picture: In the bakery, the baker hands Emma a paper bag of rolls across the counter. Emma takes it with a grateful smile.

u1-l2#prosim.picture: Emma holds the dormitory door open for pani Horváthová, who carries a stack of books. Both smile: she has just said thank you and Emma is answering.

u1-l2#nech-sa-paci.picture: On a busy tram, Emma stands up and offers her seat to an elderly lady with a walking stick and a heavy bag.

u1-l2#choice-nech-sa-paci.picture: Marek, in his chef's jacket, sets a steaming plate of halušky on a restaurant table in front of the viewer, smiling.

u1-l2#ano-prosim.picture: In the dorm kitchen, Tomáš holds up a coffee pot with raised eyebrows; Emma nods eagerly and holds out her mug.

u1-l2#prepacte.picture: In the university canteen, Emma turns with her tray and bumps into Tomáš, who is carrying his. His glass of juice tips over and spills. Emma looks apologetic.

u1-l2#nic-sa-nestalo.picture: In the canteen, Tomáš mops up the spilled juice with a napkin and waves it off with a smile; Emma still looks sheepish.

u1-l2#choice-prepacte.picture: In the dormitory corridor, Emma hurries round a corner and almost collides with pán Kováč; both step back in surprise.

u1-l2#na-zdravie.picture: Two halves for the two meanings. Left: Emma, Lucia and Tomáš clink glasses of kofola at a pub table. Right: Tomáš sneezes into a tissue while Lucia turns to him.

u1-l2#choice-na-zdravie.picture: On a train, Tomáš sneezes into a tissue; Emma, in the seat next to him, turns towards him.

u1-l3#ako-sa-mas.picture: Emma at a tram stop, smiling into her phone as she asks a friend how they are.

u1-l3#mam-sa-dobre.picture: One of three linked pictures of Tomáš on the same park bench, with the weather matching his mood. This one: partly cloudy, he sits relaxed with a content smile.

u1-l3#mam-sa-vyborne.picture: Tomáš on the same park bench in bright sunshine, beaming, an ice cream in hand.

u1-l3#mam-sa-zle.picture: Tomáš on the same park bench in pouring rain, no umbrella, soaked and gloomy.

u1-l3#ako-sa-volas.picture: At a student welcome party, Lucia turns to Emma, a new face, with a friendly, curious look, a drink in her hand.

u1-l3#volam-sa-emma.picture: At the welcome party, Emma introduces herself, a hand on her chest, a blank name sticker on her cardigan.

u1-l3#tesi-ma.picture: Emma and Tomáš shake hands warmly; Lucia, beside them, has just introduced them.

u1-l4#grammar-two-ways-say.picture: Split picture. Left: Emma chats with Lucia on the dorm sofa, relaxed, feet tucked up. Right: Emma talks with pani Horváthová in her office, standing upright and polite.
